claims.statement: For a supplied BoxFamily F and FullApproximation proof for F.family, one hAct in (0,1) works for all 0<h<hAct, all p in the cube, all weakly active labels, and all coordinates, with strict error below E at the fixed label slope.
assumptions: F is a BoxFamily, hence has a finite nonempty label index and slopes in InCube a b
no continuity or regularity of E

quantifier_contract.scale: every real h with 0 < h < hAct
quantifier_contract.points: every p satisfying InCube a b p
quantifier_contract.labels: every j with weak Active against all family labels
quantifier_contract.limit_sequences: FullApproximation allows unrestricted pSeq; only its limit p must be in the cube
quantifier_contract.activity: weak and eventual on atTop; ties are included

claims.proof_mechanism: Contradiction yields a sequence of bad scales, cube points, active labels, and bad coordinates. Extract one infinite fiber of the finite label-coordinate product, then a compactly convergent subsequence of cube points. Apply FullApproximation to the fixed label and pass the closed non-strict coordinate violation to the limit. E is evaluated at one fixed slope.
claims.replay_scope: Parent reports verify_uniform_activity.sh exited 0. This audit did not replay it because shared project outputs were parent-owned during the audit.
claims.falsifier: A clean serialized replay failure, an unexpected theorem binder, an extra nonstandard axiom or sorryAx, a failure to extract a fixed label-coordinate pair, or a mismatch in the source quantifiers.
claims.limits: The declaration is conditional on FullApproximation and does not itself construct F. It gives no effective value for hAct. It formalizes only the fixed-family uniform corollary, not the later permanence dynamics.

claims.statement: Given a≤b and E positive on the cube, exists_full_affine_family supplies F, FamilyLittleOAt F a, and FullApproximation; applying exists_uniform_activity_cutoff gives the source corollary for a family supplied by the affine lemma.
claims.status: derivable-by-composition; no separate combined declaration in UniformActivity.lean
claims.limits: Composition is a direct application of the two public declarations and has no external SliceOracle premise. The combined existential result was not separately compiled or audited as a declaration in this task.

scope_boundary.source_claim: The affine approximation lemma and its fixed-family uniform activity corollary.
scope_boundary.not_established: The all-dimensional endotactic permanence theorem and downstream weighted drift, trajectory, compactness/entry, and physical-time continuation steps.
